## lfdr at all-successes (x0 = k0): plug-in identified set (A) vs confidence-box interval (B)

For het designs k0 = 10. npmle_plugin = mean (SD across replicates). A = identified set under the *fitted* NPMLE marginal (not a confidence interval); B = union of identified sets over a 95% Bonferroni Clopper-Pearson box for the marginal. Cover = fraction of replicates whose interval contains the oracle lfdr. B_upper_le_q = fraction of replicates in which even the most pessimistic G compatible with the box gives lfdr <= q.
